newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia SBI powers to five-month high, gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia SBI powers to five-month high, gains seen.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI share index climbed 2.15 percent on Wednesday to end at 1,524.45, its highest level since February 11 when it stood at 1,521.83.
Market participants said foreign demand was likely to continue pushing prices even further up on high volume, unless rules for foreign buyers were changed.
* The SBI index jumped 32.15 points to 1,524.45.
* Petrol trader Petrol was the most actively traded share, jumping 5.65 percent or 1,270 tolars to 23,750 tolars on volume of 11,899 shares.
* Financial consultancy Primofin was the top gainer, jumping 10 percent to 9,680 tolars on volume of only 10 shares.
